pipeline_name: Western Energy Storage and Transportation Header Project

validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real, well-documented project. Independently confirmed by (1) Oil & Gas Journal, 'Magnum holds open season for WEST Header Project', 2018-06-29 (Magnum Energy Midstream Holdings LLC held a nonbinding nonbinding open season 2018-07-02 to 2018-08-31 for a bidirectional interstate gas pipeline); (2) Pipeline & Gas Journal / Pipeline News, October 2018 issue, 'Planned Projects' listing (Aug-2018 revision): 'MAGNUM ENERGY MIDSTREAM HOLDINGS LLC -- Project: Western Energy Storage and Transportation Header Project -- Type: construction of a pipeline header system -- Length: 650 miles -- Location: Salt Lake City, UT - Yuma, AZ'; (3) EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook, tracked across 28 releases 2019-01 through 2026-08 (project_key 'western energy storage and transportation west header project|magnum gas storage llc'). CLASSIFICATION: correctly a New Pipeline / interstate transmission header (EIA project_type='New Pipeline', pipeline_type='Interstate'), not a gathering/process line -- no reclassification needed. DUPLICATE: checked against all 41 other rows on the A7 roster; nothing else on the roster names Magnum, Salt Lake City, or a Utah-Arizona header -- not a duplicate of any roster row. (See cross_row_leads for a possible geographic overlap with P0404, a much smaller, differently-scoped border-crossing project, which is NOT treated as a duplicate given the order-of-magnitude spec mismatch: P0404 is 160 mi / 130 MMcf/d vs this row's 650 mi / 2000 MMcf/d.) SPEC: sheet values (Capacity 2000.00 MMcf/d, LengthKnown 650.00 mi, Diameter 24/36/42/48 in, Status cancelled) all agree exactly with the EIA Aug-2026 release's pre-matched 'strong' record (Historical Projects (1996-2024) sheet, Excel row 1144); Length and the Salt Lake City-Yuma route also agree exactly with the independent Pipeline & Gas Journal listing. No material disagreement found on any spec cell -- see fills[] for the individual REFS_ADDED records. Route geometry (routes repo P0304.geojson, 1 feature, lon -115.15 to -111.87 W / lat 32.61 to 40.76 N) is consistent with a Salt Lake City-to-Yuma-area corridor; no route/sheet mismatch found.

validity.researcher_notes: The sheet's recorded Owner1 'Magnum Energy Midstream Holdings' (100%) is directly confirmed by two independent, dated press sources (OGJ 2018-06-29 and Pipeline & Gas Journal Aug-2018 rev, both naming 'Magnum Energy Midstream Holdings LLC' as the entity sponsoring/holding the open season for this exact project) -- see the Operator and Owner fills. However, EIA's 'Pipeline Operator Name' field for this project carries a DIFFERENT but related entity, 'Magnum Gas Storage LLC', across all 28 releases 2019-01 to 2026-08 -- that is the affiliate that operates Magnum's Delta, UT salt-cavern storage facility the header pipeline was designed to connect to. This is not staged as a contradiction (OGJ/PGJ are primary press directly naming the pipeline's corporate sponsor, and the sheet's own spelling already matches them, not EIA), but the two-entity structure (storage operator vs. pipeline-project sponsor, both under the Magnum umbrella) is worth a QC read in case a future source clarifies a formal Operator/Owner split between the two.
